items.title: How long could drift go unnoticed, depending on how often you check?
items.description: Drag how often drift detection actually runs (a scheduled job, or a manual habit) and see how long a real drift — like the opening scenario's console resize — could sit undetected in the worst case: if the drift happens right after a check, it waits the full interval before anyone notices. (The average case is always exactly half of this — a fixed ratio, not independent information.)

outputs.label: Worst-case days until drift is caught
